defs.def: an unusual, exciting or dangerous experience, journey or series of events 冒险；冒险经历；奇遇

ex.s: AI transforms a standard museum trip into a personalized and interactive adventure.
ex.t: 人工智能把一次普通的博物馆之行变成个性化、互动性的探索体验。

ex.s: Tom Sawyer Play Is an Adventure
ex.t: 《汤姆·索亚》戏剧是一场冒险

ex.s: “Tom Sawyer: A River Adventure” has all the good stuff, including the fence painting, the graveyard, the island and the cave.
ex.t: 《汤姆·索亚：河流冒险》包含所有精彩元素，包括刷栅栏、墓地、小岛和山洞。

ex.s: Who wrote the music for “Tom Sawyer: A River Adventure”?
ex.t: 谁为《汤姆·索亚：河流冒险》谱写了音乐？

ex.s: Here are some suggestions on where to start your Bangkok eating adventure.
ex.t: 以下是一些关于从哪里开始你的曼谷美食之旅的建议。

ex.s: Due to 65 growing popularity of environmentally-related and adventure travel, various types 66 trips are now being classified as ecotourism.
ex.t: 由于与环保和探险旅行相关的日益增长的受欢迎程度，各种66旅行现在被分类

ex.s: Pali Overnight Adventures offers children and teens exciting experiences this summer.
ex.t: 从广播到街头艺术，这只是17个独特夏令营中的4个。

ex.s: How many camps does Pali Overnight Adventures offer this summer?
ex.t: Pali Overnight Adventures今年夏天提供多少个营地？

ex.s: Stories were like air to me and while other kids played ball or went to parties, I lived out adventures through the books I checked out from the library.
ex.t: 故事对我来说就像空气一样，当其他孩子在打球或参加派对时，我从图书馆借阅的书本中体验着冒险。

ex.s: You might also design an adventure challenge to train young volunteers.
ex.t: 我们的志愿者大多年龄在17-24岁之间。现在我们需要年龄在25-75岁之间的志愿者管理者。他们对于我们项目的安全有效运行非常重要。

ex.s: If you’re looking for a unique adventure, the Space and Aviation Center (SAC) is the place to be.
ex.t: 如果你在寻找独特的冒险，太空与航空中心（SAC）是不二之选。

ex.s: The Adventure of Tom Sawyer is a great book.
ex.t: 《汤姆·索亚历险记》是一本很棒的书。

ex.s: Adventure tourism: tavellers explore unusual or remote destinations, often engaging in risky activities.
ex.t: 探险旅游：小吃商探索不寻常或偏远的目的地，经常从事危险活动。

ex.s: The world is one ultimate adventure to you.
ex.t: 对您来说，世界是一场终极冒险。

ex.s: While climbing Mount Qomolangma might be a step too far, you have a healthy sense of adventure.
ex.t: 虽然攀登珠穆朗玛峰可能有些太过了，但你有一种健康的冒险精神。

ex.s: Yes, it was a huge goodbye in so many ways, but it was also the start of something new — an adventure in multigenerational living.
ex.t: 是的，从很多方面说这是一次巨大的告别，但它也是新事物的开端——一场多代同堂生活的冒险。

ex.s: I tend to travel with a few of my friends to state parks or to the countryside to go on adventures and take photos along the way.
ex.t: 我倾向于和几个朋友去州立公园或乡村冒险，沿途拍照。

ex.s: But something inside me was going to climb that mountain at all cost． I could hardly wait to try this adventure again．
ex.t: 但我内心有股力量要不惜一切代价去爬那座山。我迫不及待地想再试一次这次冒险。

ex.s: Take a look at our new offer: a once-in-a-lifetime adventure to the beautiful islands of Hawaii!
ex.t: 看看我们的新优惠：美丽的夏威夷岛屿千载难逢的冒险之旅！

defs.def: excitement and the willingness to take risks, try new ideas, etc. 冒险的刺激；大胆开拓

ex.s: Lead a life of adventure.
ex.t: 过一种冒险的生活。
